children: Salesforce, Inc. (NYSE:CRM) is leaning into AI and service automation—posting $11.3B revenue and $33.5B RPOs while closing Fin, pursuing Listen Labs talks, investing $300M in Anthropic, growing Agentforce ARR past $1.5B, and landing deals from FIDE to ADAMA ahead of Dreamforce.

: Salesforce (CRM) Q revenue $11.3B; remaining performance obligations $33.5B. Agentforce ARR topped $1.5B, up >3x YoY and ~3.2% of FY revenue midpoint. Contracted obligations ~72% of annual guidance.
: Salesforce (CRM) closed acquisition of Fin, adding its AI-driven multi-channel support platform (30,000+ customers) and team to boost Salesforce’s AI Labs and service automation offerings.
Salesforce, Inc. In Talks Listen Labs
: Salesforce (CRM) reportedly held talks to buy AI customer-research firm Listen Labs for about $2 billion; discussions were ongoing, terms unsettled and not confirmed by company spokespeople.
: RBC Capital kept CRM at Hold with a $250 target ahead of Dreamforce and analyst day; traders focus on AI adoption metrics and near-term milestones for performance signals.
: Salesforce (CRM) plans to invest about $300M in Anthropic’s AI coding tools; CEO Marc Benioff praised Anthropic’s potential.
: Salesforce (CRM) struck a multiyear deal with FIDE as title sponsor and AI partner, deploying Agentforce 360, Chess Concierge, Move-of-the-Day, real-time ELO rating agent and Data 360.
: Salesforce (CRM) is showcasing faster localized deployments at Dreamforce 2026; early rollouts include ADAMA’s Agentforce across 19 countries and a Campfire-built sales commission calculator.
This is an AI-generated summary and may contain inaccuracies. Please verify any important information with the original sources.

title: Weekly Recap: Q revenue $11.3B; Agentforce ARR >$1.5B and Fin buy adds AI support
